preadmit_sends_nothing.detail: Bob's node holds Alice's signed community (admissions, his message, a name, a wrap) and its own removal; it opens a link Mallory made naming her own key and a real Noise KK session to it is established. On the node's own store the rooms view gives that session only Room.take c; the running steps (Mallory's hello, a fingerprint round, an id round, a want for every op of c Bob holds and the served queue, filedGive, tickGive) and a whole Node.onTick with the family's hooks, its sealed frame opened with Bob's send key, send no op of c and only empty id claims about c, while Mallory's op of c is wanted and taken. The shipped selection, on the same store, syncs c and serves Bob's message. Then Dave, admitted after Bob's removal, invites him: that session takes c, takes Bob's new admission, and once Dave's ops are held c is synced and Bob live.
